Enterprise and compliance environments: single-tenant or BYOC deployments, KMS/BYOK, SOC 2 or similar controls. Running stateful systems in production: Postgres, Redis, or search engines like Vespa or Elasticsearch. Multi-cloud or neocloud operations (GCP, CoreWeave, or similar). FinOps: cost attribution, Savings Plans and reservations, and making infrastructure cheaper without making it fragile. Compensation Range: $220K - $405K
